subject: Executive approval request: 25% Hosted API discount for MediScale
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Evan Cole <evan.cole@mediscale.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for pilot and scaling — request for approval

Evan — thanks again for the call this morning. MediScale's usage profile from the pilot looks promising and they're asking for a commercial offer that supports a stepped ramp:

- Year 1: 3M tokens/month average during Q3–Q4 ramp, expected 20M tokens/month by end of year 1 post-integration.
- Requested pricing: 25% off list for Hosted API usage (upfront for first 12 months).

Quick context for our exec review: MediScale is an advanced imaging workflow vendor; if we secure them they plan to embed our Hosted API across three product lines and propose a 12–18 month exclusivity window for our inference runtime in one product. They will commit to a 12-month minimum and are willing to prepay 50% of estimated Year 1 consumption.

I've attached the mutual action plan and the draft term sheet. Ben, could you please flag any immediate billing or compliance concerns? Evan, if you can confirm the prepay cadence and expected quarter-by-quarter ramp I will loop in Sales Ops and submit this for exec approval.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0142

Attachments: MediScale_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx, term_sheet_MediScale_v2.docx

From: Evan Cole <evan.cole@mediscale.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@mediscale.ai>
Date: 2028-05-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for pilot and scaling — request for approval

Laura — appreciate the summary. A few clarifications from our side:

1) The 25% figure is what our CFO is asking for to make the economics work against a competing vendor. We prefer a list-discount approach rather than a custom SKU so internal procurement stays simple.
2) We can do a 12-month minimum with a 50% prepay on execution and the remainder billed monthly.
3) We need SOC 2 Type II evidence and an expanded data retention clause for PHI-derived metadata (we'll provide suggested language).

I've attached a short note from our procurement lead on the retention language. Happy to take whichever model makes the approval easiest on your side.

—Evan
Evan Cole
VP, Commercial Operations | MediScale
evan.cole@mediscale.ai

Attachment referenced: mediscale_retention_note.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Executive approval request: 25% Hosted API discount for MediScale

Karthik / Laura — forwarding the thread and MAP. Short summary and ask for exec sign-off:

- Ask: Approve up to 25% off Hosted API list rate for Year 1 consumption for MediScale (deal MS-2028-029).
- Rationale: Strategic vertical reference in medical imaging, multi-product embed, potential to convert to Dedicated in Year 2.
- Commitment: 12-month minimum, 50% prepay on signature, escrows on usage overages (we'd bill overage at list).
- Risks: PHI-related retention language requested; legal needs to approve SLA redlines (we included redline_sla.pdf).

Suggested conditional approval terms to keep downside small:
1) 25% discount capped for Year 1 only; revert to standard volume tiers thereafter.
2) Prepay 50% non-refundable against the 12-month estimate.
3) Usage cap protection: negotiated monthly caps with automatic throttle if exceeded (customer can buy overage at list).
4) Legal sign-off on redline_sla.pdf and KMS requirements for PHI metadata.

Please see the attached MAP and term sheet. If you can approve with these conditions, I'll instruct Contracts to prepare a one-off SKU and DocuSign the term sheet.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T15:44:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Executive approval request: 25% Hosted API discount for MediScale

Laura / Ben — thanks for the concise summary. I approve a one-time 25% discount on Hosted API list pricing for Year 1 under the following firm conditions:

1) 12-month minimum commitment executed on our term sheet (deal id MS-2028-029).
2) 50% prepayment required at signature and applied to Year 1 consumption.
3) Discount applies only to Hosted API usage tokens (no discounts on add-ons, embeddings, or egress).
4) All legal redlines must be closed: redline_sla.pdf accepted by Legal, and SOC 2 evidence provided before go-live.
5) Discount expires automatically after 12 months and rates revert to standard volume pricing unless a renewal agreement is signed.

Ben — please route to Contracts to issue a one-off SKU with the cap/overage protections and generate DocuSign. Laura — coordinate with Evan on SOC 2 docs and the retention language; loop Legal on the PHI clause.

Karthik Iyer
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
